reason: Report-time evaluation catches the new marker, but reevaluating an already active condition after the test can reverse its outcome, and two unrecorded tests in the patch deliberately fail when collected.
The early return prevents the warning for empty lists, but it collapses every multidimensional empty array to shape (0,), and the five recorded tests do not check empty inputs.

Lazy validation initializes the supplied vocabulary for get_feature_names, but the shared check now accepts any non-None vocabulary even if vocabulary_ is missing, a state the recorded tests do not cover.
Using str preserves the example comment, but short scientific values such as 1e-07 now bypass FITS uppercase exponent formatting, which none of the recorded tests exercises.
